title: What If You Were Trapped in a World Ruled by Women?
tags: what if gender roles were reversed
description:
There's a glowing circle on the floor of your chemistry classroom. You and the girl two rows ahead of you fall through it. A queen in full armor looks at her and says: "The Hero." Then she looks at you. "And her luggage."

In this world, girls are the knights. They carry the swords, ride the horses, sit at the war table. Men light the kitchen fires at 4 AM, wash eighty wool cloaks in the river, sew the padded shirts that go under the chainmail, and are not allowed to hold a blade. Not even the one for bread.

She gets armor fitted by three blacksmiths. You get a blue apron with a sheep on it.

She's level 4. Then 19. Then 31. You're level 1. For twelve days.

Then the Demon Lord shows up at the gates, takes off his helmet, and asks — in English — if you're from Ohio.

In this episode of Gus Maybe:
– The Scythian "Amazon" graves where about a third of the warrior burials were women
– The Agojie of Dahomey, and why "who holds the spear" decides who the world calls strong
– Why your brother thinks a world that won't let him fight is the best thing that ever happened to him
– And what a level-one guy with a broom handle says to the man who wants to burn the kingdom down

Be honest: you get the apron, she gets the sword. Do you swing the broom, or do you do what my brother did and marry three knights? Comment "broom" or "knights."

New What If every day. Subscribe.
